description.shortText: AI and machine learning are incorporated within threat intelligence and detection solutions, using algorithms to detect patterns and help identify and act upon threats before they can do harm. AI’s ability to adaptively learn and detect novel patterns can accelerate detection, containment, and response, easing the burden on SOC analysts and allowing them to be more proactive.
